lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty-nine? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 29? Nope!

lines.text: Look at every minute from one o'clock to one fifty-nine.
lines.caption: Look at every minute from 1:00 to 1:59.

lines.text: At how many of those times is the smaller angle between the hands a whole number of degrees?
lines.caption: At how many of those times is the smaller angle between the hands a whole number of degrees?

lines.text: The minute hand moves six degrees a minute. That's always a whole number.
lines.caption: The minute hand moves 6 degrees a minute. That's always a whole number.

lines.text: The hour hand starts at thirty, and moves half a degree a minute.
lines.caption: The hour hand starts at 30, and moves half a degree a minute.

lines.text: On odd minutes, it's on a half, like thirty and a half. On even minutes, it's whole.
lines.caption: On odd minutes, it's on a half, like 30 and a half. On even minutes, it's whole.

lines.text: Whole minus a half is never whole. So the angle is whole every other minute!
lines.caption: Whole minus a half is never whole. So the angle is whole every other minute!

lines.text: Half of the sixty times. That's thirty!
lines.caption: Half of the 60 times. That's 30!

lines.text: Twenty-nine was the trap. It forgets one o'clock.
lines.caption: 29 was the trap. It forgets 1:00.

lines.text: Did you get thirty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 30? Tell me below!
